titulo: Molson Coors (Oct 2025): $1.02 billion to shareholders, about 400 salaried jobs planned. The math.
descripcion:
From the archive: Oct 2025. Not today's news.
Molson Coors, Oct 20, 2025 (Rahul Goyal CEO, press release): "given the environment, we must transform even faster"
On Oct. 20, 2025, Molson Coors said it plans to eliminate approximately 400 salaried positions in its Americas business. Its 2025 cash flow statement shows $1.02 billion in dividends and treasury stock purchases.

Same year: $1.02 billion to shareholders, 2025, company-wide. $647.9 million paid for treasury stock plus $376.3 million of dividends in 2025, company-wide (cash flow statement, in millions).
The math: $1.02 billion to shareholders (2025) ÷ about 400 salaried jobs cut = about $2.56 million to shareholders per Americas job cut.
The facts: $1.02 billion to shareholders, 2025, company-wide (Molson Coors 2025 10-K (SEC), Feb 18, 2026). about 400 salaried jobs planned cuts (Molson Coors 8-K release (SEC), Oct 20, 2025). The $1.02 billion is company-wide cash paid in 2025: dividends plus treasury stock purchases, from the cash flow statement. The 400 is the release's approximate figure for its Americas business, by the end of December 2025. The ratio mixes two scopes.

Transform even faster. Here is the shareholder column. (Our take.)
